release_notes: Mandatory OPS 4.5.21 client-only Task photo UI correction. Removes duplicate global photo-save overlays and the misleading Task autosave toast triggered by file inputs. A captured photo appears directly inside its own Task photo group. Photo upload or registration failure stays on that photo tile with Retry and Delete only. Existing camera, assignment, Worker v21, D1 schema, Task records and TaskPhoto records are unchanged.
